records.title: Execute reviewed browser quality checks with traceable evidence
records.description:
As a Quality Engineer, I want to run reviewed web, security, performance, accessibility and visual checks against an explicitly scoped application.

A typed browser plan is reviewed before execution. Durable scoped jobs return recorded stages, measured metrics, findings and authenticated screenshot artifacts. Findings can become reviewed Defects and visual captures can become explicitly approved baselines.

Acceptance criteria
1. Select one of five default agents, a scoped target URL and bounded browser settings; review concrete journey steps before running a web goal.
2. Inspect actual execution stages, measurements, findings and screenshots; stop a queued or running job without late responses replacing its cancelled state.
3. Compare matching visual captures against a human-approved baseline; preserve viewport, target, masks, reviewer and screenshot integrity.
4. Review and edit a finding-derived Defect draft before saving through the authorized Defects API.

Failure and scope boundary
Missing browser infrastructure or incomplete steps block execution. Passive security, single-navigation performance and automated accessibility checks disclose their limits; an unapproved visual capture cannot claim a passed regression.
